name: 通話中のカメラと会話の操作
prompt:
Create version 2 of the Japanese call-controls toolbar at exactly 390×96 pixels. The original source crop is the exact reference for icon silhouettes. The native Japanese preview is the exact reference for label wording, label placement, toolbar spacing, button positions and the green palette. The white no-tint candidate v001 is a surface and geometry reference only; replace its mismatched icon drawings.

Correct the source icon mismatches precisely: camera must be OFF with a diagonal slash across the rectangular camera and its side lens; microphone must use the same upright capsule, stem and base silhouette as the source; conversation must use the source filled speech-bubble silhouette with its lower-left tail; 一緒に遊ぶ must use the source game-controller silhouette with its D-pad and two face buttons, not people; 通話終了 must use the source curved telephone receiver silhouette, not a generic diagonal outline handset. Keep these five symbols close to the supplied source crop in shape and proportions. Do not simplify them into generic replacements.

No tinted surfaces. Keep the page white #FFFFFF. The first four existing pill controls are white with only a fine neutral #E2E8E5 outline. Do not restore pale gray or mint circles from the source screenshot, and do not use pastel fills, gradients, glows or shadows. Keep the first four source-matching icons forest green #047857. Preserve the final 通話終了 button as solid dark green #064E3B with a white source-matching handset icon. The five labels remain neutral gray #6E6E6E. No hyperlink appears here, so no label is blue and no link is added.

Keep the 390×96 canvas and exact native placement: button bounds x16, 90, 164, 238, 312; y8; each 62×46 with 23px corners. Label baselines and positions match the native preview: Meiryo Regular 12px at y65 in 66px areas x14, 88, 162, 236, 310. Exact text and order: カメラ, マイク, 会話, 一緒に遊ぶ, 通話終了. Retain the native icon-size boxes and avoid enlarging the controls. Keep all icons centered inside their original buttons, with the labels centered below. No extra title, copy, wallpaper, device frame, controls or decoration. Return the flat toolbar only, with no outside margin.
reviewNotes: User feedback on v001 was honored: v002 now matches the source crossed-out camera, microphone, filled chat bubble, gamepad, and handset silhouettes. No tinted fills; white outlined controls and dark green call-ending action remain, and no hyperlink exists. Compared to native bounds, buttons/icons remain visibly a few pixels oversized, so retain needs-correction after two bounded attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.purpose: Icon-focused correction to match the original source silhouettes while retaining native Japanese labels/layout and user-directed untinted surfaces.
